questions.question: The general speed limit on a public road in an urban area is 80 km/h.
questions.explanation: The general speed limit in an urban area is 60 km/h.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.27 (p.24)

questions.question: Which control is used to select a gear?
questions.explanation: The gear lever (6).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Stop – but you may turn left without stopping if you yield to traffic

questions.explanation: Stop/yield sign (R1.2): if you go straight you must stop; when turning left you may proceed without stopping but must yield to all traffic close enough to be a hazard.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R1.2 (p.4)

questions.question: What should you do when you approach this sign?

options.text: Slow down and switch your headlights on in the dipped position

questions.explanation: Tunnel (W319): slow down and switch your car's headlights on in the dim position.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W319 (p.28)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep right (pass to the right of the obstruction)

questions.explanation: Proceed left only (R105): drive only in the direction indicated by the arrow.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R105 (p.6)

questions.question: A freeway confirmation sign (GA7) is placed about ____ after you enter a freeway, and every 5 to 10 km after that.
questions.explanation: Confirmation (GA7): about 750 m after entering a freeway and after that every 5 to 10 km.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §5.2 GA7 (p.43)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Pedestrians prohibited".
questions.explanation: Pedestrians prohibited (R218): pedestrians may not enter or cross the road; drivers must still look out for them.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R218 (p.13)

questions.question: When towing, the tow-rope, chain or tow-bar between the vehicles may not be longer than ____.
questions.explanation: You may not tow if the tow-rope, chain or tow-bar exceeds 3,5 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.57 (p.36)

questions.question: Link each numbered control with its name.
questions.explanation: 3 = Left and right rear-view mirrors. 6 = Gear lever. 11 = Horn. 8 = Clutch.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: What must you do with your lights where this sign is displayed?

options.text: Switch the headlamps on in the dipped position
Switch the parking lamps on only

questions.explanation: Switch headlamps on (R133): switch your lights on in the dip position to see and be seen.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R133 (p.10)

questions.question: What is "counter steering"?

options.text: Turning the steering wheel back so that the wheels are straight just before coming to a standstill

questions.explanation: Counter steering: turning the wheel opposite to the direction of travel so the wheels are at least straight immediately before stopping.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Steering – counter steer (p.84)

questions.question: What is the maximum overall length of a single rigid vehicle (not a trailer, articulated vehicle or bus-train)?
questions.explanation: Any other (single) vehicle may not exceed 12,5 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.30 (p.24)

questions.question: What does the Exclusive parking bay marking "L" mean?

options.text: Loading zone – only goods vehicles may stop or park there

questions.explanation: Exclusive parking bay (RM7): L = loading zone; only goods vehicles may stop or park in the demarcated loading zone.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM7 (p.50)

questions.question: This sign means: "Minibuses prohibited".
questions.explanation: Minibuses prohibited (R225).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R225 (p.13)

questions.question: The parking brake should not be applied while the vehicle is moving, except if the service brake fails.
questions.explanation: The parking brake should not be applied while in motion except in the case of a service brake failure.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Parking brake (p.83)

questions.question: This sign means: "Pedestrians prohibited".
questions.explanation: Pedestrians prohibited (R218): pedestrians may not enter or cross the road; drivers must still look out for them.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R218 (p.13)

questions.question: When control 9 is used, the stopping distance is longer… (Select all that apply.)

options.text: When the vehicle is facing uphill on a dry road
On a wet road than on a dry road

questions.explanation: All three: wet road, higher speed and a loaded vehicle each lengthen the stopping distance.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: What is a "direction indicator"?

options.text: A device enabling the driver to show the intention to change direction to the right or left

questions.explanation: "Direction indicator" means a device fitted to a vehicle enabling the driver to intimate the intention to change direction to the right or left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.3)

questions.question: What are "blind spots"?

options.text: Areas on either side of a vehicle not visible to the driver even with the rear-view mirrors
Areas in front of the bonnet
Dark parts of the road at night

questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas on either side of a vehicle not visible even with the mirrors; they can only be eliminated by turning the head (looking over the shoulder).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Blind spots (p.79)

questions.question: Which sign means: "You have right of way at the intersection ahead"?
questions.explanation: Right of way (IN7): you have right of way at the intersection ahead, but make sure other traffic yields.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §6 IN7 (p.46)

questions.question: The speed shown on this sign is a speed limit that you must not exceed.
questions.explanation: Co-ordinated traffic signals (IN14): the speed indicated is a recommendation and not a speed limit.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §6 IN14 (p.47)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Minimum speed 50 km/h".
questions.explanation: Minimum speed sign (R101): do not drive slower than the speed shown in km/h.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R101 (p.6)

questions.question: It is an offence to disregard regulatory road markings, just like regulatory signs.
questions.explanation: As with regulatory signs, it is an offence to disregard regulatory markings.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §1 Signs in general (p.2)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Danger plate: do not pass to the right of it
Delineator plate: do not pass to the left of it
T-junction chevron: road does not continue straight

questions.explanation: Sharp curve chevron (W405/W407): the road curves suddenly to the right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W405 (p.34)

questions.question: After switching off the engine of a manual car parked on a slope, selecting a gear is a precaution against moving, but the manual does not recommend this for a diesel vehicle.
questions.explanation: Having switched off, an appropriate gear may be selected as a precaution; this procedure is not recommended for a diesel vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 31 (p.52)

questions.question: Animals are crossing the road in front of you. When may you continue?

options.text: When the first animal reaches the other side
Only when all the animals have crossed and it is safe

questions.explanation: When animals are crossing, you may only move when all the animals have crossed and the road is safe.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.60 (p.36)

questions.question: This sign means: "Danger plate: do not pass to the right of it".
questions.explanation: False. Temporary barricade (W411): part of the road is temporarily closed; do not drive past. ("Danger plate: do not pass to the right of it" is the meaning of W401.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W411 (p.34)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Only vehicles with a GVM/GCM above the mass shown (10 t) may use this road"?
questions.explanation: Vehicles exceeding mass only (R102): vehicles with a GVM or GCM above the tonnage shown must use the road indicated; lighter vehicles must not.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R102 (p.6)

questions.question: What is "clutch control" (the contact or friction point)?

options.text: A switch that turns off the clutch
The point where the flywheel, clutch plate and pressure plate meet and engine power starts to be transferred
The highest position of the clutch pedal
The point where the clutch pedal touches the floor

questions.explanation: Clutch control is obtained at the contact (friction) point, where the flywheel, clutch plate and pressure plate meet, transferring engine power.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Clutch – control (p.79)

questions.question: This sign means: "Road narrows from both sides".
questions.explanation: Road narrows from both sides (W328).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W328 (p.29)

questions.question: Tap the horn in this automatic-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The horn is control 11.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: The windscreen of a vehicle must have a visible light transmittance of at least ____.
questions.explanation: The windscreen must have a visible light transmittance of at least 70%.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.19 (p.21)

questions.question: Which picture shows the hand signal for: stopping or sudden reduction of speed?
questions.explanation: Stop or sudden reduction of speed: extend the right arm sideways from the shoulder with the forearm vertical and upward and the palm to the front.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 9 (p.25)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Elephants ahead"?
questions.explanation: Elephant (W357).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W357 (p.33)

questions.question: You only have to give way at a yield line if there is also a yield sign.
questions.explanation: Yield line (RTM2): give way to anyone crossing your path even if there is no yield sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RTM2 (p.48)

questions.question: Match each towing rule to its limit.

options.text: Maximum length of tow-rope, chain or tow-bar
Maximum speed when towing with a rope or chain
Who may steer the towed vehicle
A person licensed to drive that class of vehicle

questions.explanation: Tow-rope/chain/tow-bar ≤3,5 m; ≤30 km/h with a rope or chain; the towed vehicle must be steered by a person licensed for that class.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.57 (p.36)

questions.question: The tare of a vehicle includes the mass of the fuel in the tank.
questions.explanation: Tare does not include the mass of fuel.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.8)–9

questions.question: Driving a vehicle without reasonable consideration for other road users is an offence.
questions.explanation: No person shall drive a vehicle without reasonable consideration for any other person using the road (inconsiderate driving).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.63 (p.38)

questions.question: With which foot should the service (foot) brake be applied?
questions.explanation: The service/foot brake should be applied timeously, smoothly and progressively using the right foot.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Braking (p.79)

questions.question: What is the "shoulder" of a road?

options.text: The part beyond the kerb line
The portion of the road between the edge of the roadway and the kerb line

questions.explanation: "Shoulder" means that portion of a road between the edge of the roadway and the kerb line.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.8)

questions.question: Match each number in the picture to the correct control.
questions.explanation: 1 = Centre rear-view mirror. 4 = Steering wheel. 8 = Clutch. 10 = Accelerator.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Road narrows (W330): from the left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W330 (p.29)

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, all wheels must be in contact with the road surface at all times.
questions.explanation: A rider must ride so that all the wheels are in contact with the road surface at all times (no wheelies).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.50 (p.33)

questions.question: At an unguarded level crossing, a heavy vehicle that must stop should stop at least how far from the nearest rail?
questions.explanation: Stop, if necessary, at a safe distance or at least 5 metres from the nearest rail.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Heavy Motor Vehicle manual, Module 46 (p.65)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Buses only (R121): the road or part of the road is set aside for buses.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R121 (p.8)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Width limit 2,1 m"?
questions.explanation: Width limit (R239): do not proceed if the overall width of your vehicle exceeds the width shown.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R239 (p.15)

questions.question: In this automatic-transmission car, what is control number 1?
questions.explanation: Control 1 is the centre rear-view mirror.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: Goods vehicles with a GVM above 10 000 kg (registered from 1 January 2001) must be fitted with yellow reflective material.
questions.explanation: Goods vehicles with a GVM exceeding 10 000 kg registered from 1 January 2001 must have reflective material fitted.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.44 (p.29)

questions.question: At a flashing amber traffic light at an intersection, who has right of way?

options.text: The traffic that was first to stop
The vehicle on the bigger road

questions.explanation: At flashing amber, right of way shall be given to traffic which was first to stop.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 43 (p.64)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Police flashing light: be ready to stop for police
Gate or boom across the road ahead

questions.explanation: Temporary police flashing light (TW347): a temporary stop sign, collision scene or roadblock with police on duty.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW347 (p.31)

questions.question: Fog lamps may be used when visibility is poor because of dust or smoke.
questions.explanation: Fog lamps may be used in poor visibility caused by snow, fog, mist, dust or smoke.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.9 (p.18)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Jetty edge or river bank ahead

questions.explanation: Low-flying aircraft (W351): do not get a fright or brake suddenly.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W351 (p.32)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Dead end: turn left or right

questions.explanation: Sharp curve chevron (W406/W408): the road curves suddenly to the left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W406 (p.34)

questions.question: In this automatic-transmission car, what is control number 5?
questions.explanation: Control 5 is the indicator light switch.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: In which situations is it NOT compulsory for the driver to wear a seatbelt? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: While moving into or out of a parking bay

questions.explanation: Wearing a seatbelt is not compulsory while reversing or moving in or out of a parking place.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.17 (p.20)

questions.question: A vehicle towed with a rope or chain may not be towed faster than ____.
questions.explanation: Towing with a rope or chain is limited to 30 km/h unless a draw bar or tow-bar is used.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.57 (p.36)

questions.question: What is a "hazard" in the K53 manuals?

options.text: Vehicles, persons, animals, objects or substances that may cause damage or injury and may require a change of speed or direction

questions.explanation: Moving hazards include vehicles, persons and animals; fixed hazards include intersections, traffic circles, lamp posts, curves, potholes, rain, dust and smoke.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Hazard (p.82)

questions.question: You are riding a motorcycle on a freeway and see this sign. What must you do?

options.text: Stop on the shoulder and wait
Continue but keep to the left lane
Leave the freeway at the first exit

questions.explanation: Motorcycles prohibited (R222): if displayed on a freeway, motorcyclists must leave at the first exit.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R222 (p.13)

questions.question: What is the "roadway"?

options.text: The whole road reserve including verges
The portion of the road improved or intended for vehicular traffic, between the edges of the roadway

questions.explanation: "Roadway" means the portion of a road improved, constructed or intended for vehicular traffic, between the edges of the roadway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.8)

questions.question: This sign means: "Traffic signals ahead".
questions.explanation: Traffic signals ahead (W301): slow down and be ready to stop if the light changes.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W301 (p.26)

questions.question: Who has right of way on the streets marked by this sign?
questions.explanation: Woonerf (R403): yield right of way to pedestrians in the street; watch for children playing.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.5 R403 (p.19)

questions.question: This sign means: "No stopping".
questions.explanation: False. Right turn ahead prohibited (R210): do not turn right at the intersection ahead. ("No stopping" is the meaning of R217.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R210 (p.12)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Left turn prohibited (you may go straight or turn right)
Mass limit: vehicles with GVM/GCM above 12 t prohibited

questions.explanation: Mass limit (R202): if your GVM or GCM exceeds the tonnage shown, use another road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R202 (p.11)

questions.question: You are parked at the side of the road and want to drive off. When may you do so?

options.text: As soon as you have signalled
Only when you can do so without interfering with moving traffic and safely
Whenever you want – moving traffic must give way

questions.explanation: You may not drive from a parked position unless you can do so without interfering with moving traffic approaching from any direction, and safely.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Turn right only (R109): you must turn in the direction of the arrow at the intersection ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R109 (p.6)

questions.question: A learner's licence is a provisional licence.
questions.explanation: A licence to drive is either a provisional licence (a learner's licence) or a driving licence.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.3 (p.14)

questions.question: Any private car may be fitted with an adjustable spot lamp for general use.
questions.explanation: Adjustable spot lamps are only allowed on certain official, emergency, medical/veterinary, breakdown and essential-service vehicles.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.10 (p.18)

questions.question: Which controls must you use when there is a sharp turn in the road?
questions.explanation: Official sample answer: 1, 4, 6, 8, 9 and 10 only (mirror, steering wheel, gear lever, clutch, brake, accelerator).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: A goods vehicle with a GVM of more than ____ is limited to 80 km/h.
questions.explanation: An 80 km/h limit applies to goods vehicles with a GVM over 9 000 kg.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.29 (p.24)

questions.question: You must obey a traffic officer who orders you to disobey a road traffic sign.
questions.explanation: You may not disobey a road traffic sign or rule of the road unless ordered to do so by a traffic officer.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: Put these steps for changing UP a gear in a manual car in the correct order.

options.text: Depress accelerator while releasing clutch completely
Release accelerator while depressing clutch completely
Place left foot on clutch pedal
Remove foot completely from clutch pedal
Release clutch slowly to contact point

questions.explanation: LMV Module 23 (gear changing up, manual transmission).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 23 (p.44)

questions.question: How often should a motorcyclist check the rear-view mirrors?
questions.explanation: Check rear-view mirrors every 5–8 seconds and on approach to any hazard.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Motor Cycles manual Part 1, Module 5 (p.22)

questions.question: Which number shows the brake in this manual-transmission car?
questions.explanation: The brake is number 9.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Buses prohibited".
questions.explanation: Buses prohibited (R227).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R227 (p.14)

questions.question: The signal shows green. What must you do?

options.text: Go immediately – you have absolute right of way

questions.explanation: Green: go if it is safe.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 Traffic signals (p.56)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved for vehicles of disabled persons

questions.explanation: Bus parking reservation (R301-P): only buses may park in the area indicated.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R301-P (p.16)

questions.question: A car has a foot-operated parking brake. In what order do you stop and secure it in traffic?

options.text: Apply the parking brake, then press the clutch
Select neutral with the service brake depressed, then apply the parking brake
Select reverse, then apply the parking brake

questions.explanation: With a foot-operated parking brake, select neutral with the service brake depressed and then apply the parking brake.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 29 (p.50)

questions.question: Which rear-view mirrors must a motor car have?

options.text: Only an exterior mirror on the left
An exterior mirror on the driver's side and an interior mirror (or an extra exterior mirror on the other side if the interior one does not give a clear view)

questions.explanation: A motor car, minibus, bus or goods vehicle needs an exterior mirror on the driving side and an interior mirror; if the interior mirror does not give a clear view, an exterior mirror on the opposite side instead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.11 (p.18)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends: the left-hand lane ends

questions.explanation: Hairpin bend (W206/W207): a very sharp U-shaped curve ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W207 (p.25)

questions.question: You must keep at least one hand on the steering wheel at all times.
questions.explanation: Keep at least one hand on the steering wheel at all times.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 14 (p.30)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Staggered junction: side road from the left first, then from the right"?
questions.explanation: Staggered junction (W110): a road joins from the left first and then from the right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.1 W110 (p.24)

questions.question: By definition, a "bus" is a motor vehicle designed or adapted to carry…

options.text: More than 12 persons, excluding the driver
More than 9 persons, including the driver
More than 16 persons, including the driver

questions.explanation: "Bus" means a motor vehicle designed or adapted for the conveyance of more than 16 persons (including the driver).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.3)

questions.question: A number plate must be fixed in an upright position or within how many degrees of upright?
questions.explanation: A number plate must be affixed upright or within 30 degrees of upright.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.8 (p.17)

questions.question: Which control is not found in an automatic vehicle?
questions.explanation: Automatic vehicles do not have a clutch control (8).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: A load that projects more than ____ to the side of the vehicle must be marked with a flag or reflectors.
questions.explanation: Any load projecting more than 150 mm to the side or 300 mm to the rear must be marked.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.36 (p.27)

questions.question: Which of the following may NOT be used on a freeway? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: A vehicle drawn by an animal
A motor car towing a caravan

questions.explanation: Animal-drawn vehicles, pedal cycles, small (≤50 cm³ or electric) motorcycles, quadrucycles, certain disability vehicles and tractors (except for freeway works) may not be used on a freeway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.56 (p.35)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?
questions.explanation: Horses and riders (W356).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W356 (p.33)

questions.question: How many adult persons may be carried in a motorcycle sidecar at most?
questions.explanation: A rider is not allowed to carry more than two adult persons in a sidecar.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.50 (p.33)

questions.question: A sidecar may not be attached to a motorcycle with an engine capacity of less than…
questions.explanation: No sidecar may be attached to a motorcycle with an engine of less than 50 cm³.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.51 (p.34)

questions.question: Put the first steps for turning left at an intersection in the correct order.

options.text: Obey all road traffic signs, signals, rules and markings
Check blind spot to the left, if applicable
Position vehicle in lane, if necessary
Check rear-view mirror(s) and blind spot to the left

questions.explanation: LMV Module 34 begins: mirrors and left blind spot; signal; obey signs; check left blind spot; position in lane.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 34 (p.55)

questions.question: Match each regulatory sign to its meaning.

options.text: Pay toll ahead (last chance to take the alternative route)
Keep left (pass to the left of the obstruction)

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R132: Pay toll ahead (last chance to take the alternative route). Sign 2 is R107: Proceed straight only. Sign 3 is R103: Keep left (pass to the left of the obstruction). Sign 4 is R105: Proceed left only.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R132 (p.9), R107 (p.6), R103 (p.6), R105 (p.6)

questions.question: What does the colour and shape of this sign tell you?

options.text: It is a command sign – you must do what it shows

questions.explanation: Command signs are blue discs with a white symbol and must be obeyed.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R105 (p.6)

questions.question: How many rear lamps must a heavy motor vehicle have at least?

options.text: At least one on each side at the rear, showing red

questions.explanation: A heavy motor vehicle must have at least one lamp on each side at the rear emitting a red light.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.5 (p.17)

questions.question: Which lane ends according to this sign?

options.text: No lane – a lane is added

questions.explanation: Lane ends (W215): the road narrows by a full lane from the left; change in good time to the lane that carries on.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W215 (p.26)

questions.question: In an urban area you may not park within ____ of any intersection.
questions.explanation: No parking within 5 m of any intersection in an urban area.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.47 (p.31)

questions.question: What is the maximum overall width of a light motor vehicle?
questions.explanation: Any vehicle other than certain buses and goods vehicles may not exceed 2,5 m in width.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.32 (p.25)

questions.question: A vehicle (or combination) longer than 7 m must have yellow side retro-reflectors. How far apart may they be at most?
questions.explanation: Vehicles longer than 7 m must be fitted with yellow side retro-reflectors not more than 3,6 m apart.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.43 (p.29)

questions.question: An automatic car has no clutch pedal.
questions.explanation: Automatic vehicles do not have a clutch control.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: What is the steering wheel used for?

options.text: To increase the speed of the vehicle
To engage or disengage a gear and to avoid stalling just before stopping
To alert other road users in order to avoid a collision
To change the direction of the vehicle (steer left or right)

questions.explanation: The steering wheel is used to change the direction of the vehicle (steer left or right).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: What is a "truck-tractor"?

options.text: Any truck with a GVM above 9 000 kg
A motor vehicle designed for drawing other vehicles and not to carry any load other than that imposed by a semi-trailer or ballast

questions.explanation: "Truck-tractor" means a motor vehicle designed for drawing other vehicles and not to carry any load other than that of a semi-trailer or ballast.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9)
